GeoGebra HTML5 Offline Runtime

The files in this directory are vendored from the local GeoGebra offline
package used by this project:

  local GGBTool offline package v2.7, lib/GeoGebra

GeoGebra's deployggb.js header states that the file is subject to the
GeoGebra Non-Commercial License Agreement:

  https://www.geogebra.org/license

These vendored GeoGebra runtime files are not covered by the ICeCream MIT
license. ICeCream source code remains MIT licensed, while the GeoGebra
runtime must be used according to GeoGebra's own license terms.
